english: Today I went to a store with my mother. I asked how much these apples were. They were five yuan each. I bought two.
reference: 今天我和妈妈去商店。我问这些苹果多少钱。五块钱一个。我买了两个。

issues.description: “went” is past tense, but the reference 今天我和妈妈去商店 has no aspect marker. 今天我和妈妈去了商店 is more natural and matches the English. Learners who write 去了商店 may be marked down by the automatic grader.
商店 (“store”) may be slightly above strict HSK 1 vocabulary, depending on the standard used. 问 (“asked”) may also be borderline. The exercise is otherwise within HSK 1 level.
